name: goss-resource-dependency-aware-validation
instr:
goss cannot declare typed prerequisites and outcome policies uniformly in YAML and JSON, or delay validation until required outcomes make resources ready. Add bounded, deterministic dependency-aware execution that embedders can observe without changing dependency-free behavior.

Resolve typed references after recursive imports and duplicate replacement. Missing-reference errors name both resources. Cycle errors name every participant before system observation. Keep acyclic readiness deterministic. Produce one terminal group per resource. Release dependents only from final outcomes under MaxConcurrent, never intermediate retries.

Keep failed, skipped, disabled, blocked, and cancelled outcomes distinct, and propagate them under success or completion policy. Across File, Group, Interface, Command, DNS, HTTP, Addr, and Gossfile, evaluate prerequisite admission once per validation attempt. Blocked resources perform no setup or probe and produce one terminal group carrying prerequisite state. Admitted resources preserve existence-first property behavior, ordering, retries, timeouts, and markers, with prerequisite state on every terminal result.

Expose completed results and terminal states without formatter parsing. Classify every resource before cancellation closes the stream. Preserve dependency-free merging, disabled resources, streams, formatting, retries, embedding, and cached health responses.
